rows.topic: Unequal Support Sag & River Crossing Clearance
rows.textLatex: An overhead line at a river crossing is supported from two towers at heights of $50\text{ m}$ and $85\text{ m}$ above water level, the horizontal distance between the towers being $450\text{ m}$. If the maximum tension is $3980\text{ Kgf}$ and the conductor weighs $1.726\text{ Kgf/m}$, find (a) the minimum clearance of the conductor from the water level (b) the clearance between the conductor and the water level at a point midway between the towers (c) clearance between the conductor and the water level at a point $200\text{ m}$ from the lower supporting tower.
Discuss the causes for electrical failure of insulators in case of overhead transmission system and how they are prevented.
Discuss the advantages of polymer insulators.
Discuss the advantages of using XLPE as cable insulation.

The test results for $1\text{ km}$ of 3-phase metal sheathed belted cable gave a measured capacitance of $0.7\text{ }\mu\text{F}$ between one conductor and other two bunched together with the sheath and $1.2\text{ }\mu\text{F}$ between the three bunched conductors and sheath. Find (a) capacitance between any pair of conductors (b) the charging current when the cable is connected to $11\text{ kV}$, $50\text{ Hz}$ supply.

For an insulated cable, prove that $\frac{g_{\max}}{g_{\min}} = \frac{R}{r}$ where $g_{\max}$ and $g_{\min}$ are the maximum and minimum stress of the cable and $r$ and $R$ are the radius of conductor and internal radius of sheath respectively. Also derive the expression for the most economical size of cable.
Discuss the features of ACSR conductor.
Illustrate the characteristics of conductor materials of a transmission line.
Illustrate the factors that influence the tariff imposed on a consumer.
Justify why diversity factor is always greater than one.

rows.topic: Surge Impedance Loading & Travelling Wave Velocity
rows.textLatex: A $400\text{ km}$ long $400\text{ kV}$ transmission line has series impedance $z = (0.01 + j0.4)\text{ ohm/km/phase}$ and shunt admittance $y = j2.5\times 10^{-6}\text{ mho/km/phase}$. Calculate (i) the surge impedance loading and (ii) velocity wave propagation of travelling wave in the line.
